responsibility: Implements GCC’s predicate-aware uninitialized-variable warning analysis on SSA GIMPLE. It performs early and late warning passes, identifies SSA names that are definitely or possibly undefined, follows PHI-induced undefinedness through worklists, reconstructs guarding predicates and dominance/post-dominance relationships to suppress cases proven safe, and emits -Wuninitialized / -Wmaybe-uninitialized diagnostics at the actual use sites or relevant PHI arguments when a use can occur without a prior definition.
